summary: A full packet whose last traded timestamp is in epoch seconds: the desktop sends ltt and last_trade_time in epoch ms, the web passes the seconds on.

deviations.reason: This web adapter puts the subscription mode number in data.mode (mstock_adapter.py:202); the desktop sends the label (ltp, quote, full). data.mode follows the web adapter in Phase B through lane wire's per-broker switch in the dialect table, set for mStock (integer).

mStock's full packet carries the last traded time in epoch seconds (web test/test_mstock_quote_feed.py: last_traded_timestamp=1730783990 beside an exchange timestamp in ms); the web sends it as ltt unconverted, in seconds, while feed timestamps are epoch milliseconds (docs/prompt/websockets-format.md). The desktop sends it in ms (brokers/mstock/streaming.rs trade_time_ms).
As ltt: the web's last_trade_time for a full packet is the raw epoch seconds; the desktop's mStock last_trade_time alias carries ltt's value in epoch ms.
deviations.ref: mstock_adapter.py:355; feed::dialect (mStock last_trade_time in ms, openalgo#2383)

deviations.reason: The web also sends mStock's exchange timestamp under its own name whenever the packet carries one (mstock_adapter.py:357-358); the desktop's common carrier has no such field, so it is lost.
deviations.ref: audit C06; WEBSOCKET_AUDIT_REMAINING_BROKERS.md 'Verified broker fields dropped' (mstock)

deviations.reason: The web sends the previous close twice, as close and as prev_close (mstock_adapter.py:366-367); the desktop sends close only, and its dialect table has no prev_close alias for mStock.
The web sends the full packet's upper circuit limit in Depth (mstock_adapter.py:425); the desktop decodes it (brokers/mstock/streaming.rs:151) but the common carrier drops it.
